• Get a food scale.
  • Figure out your TDEE.
  • Weigh all food before you eat it. Take your scale to restaurants and to parties. Weigh your food. Do not forget to weigh your food. Hey! Have you weighed your food?
  • Weigh your food for at least a month before you try not to weigh your food.
  • Weigh your food.
  • Then log the food, which will be more accurate because you weighed your food. Right?
  • Eat at least 500 below your TDEE.
  • Lift weights and do cardio. Don't neglect one or the other. Focus on weight lifting that hits more than one muscle. Squats and deadlifts are my must-dos every day that I lift.
  • Count your calories, every single calorie, including liquid calories. Did you weigh that juice you decided to drink? Of course you did, because you know to weigh everything you put into your body!
  • Avoid cheat days for at least a month, because believe me, you probably can't handle them.
  • Realize that starvation mode does not exist until you are actually, literally starving and at a very low body fat %. Any metabolism slowdowns can be fixed by lifting weights, which you're doing, right?
  • Keep lifting and counting calories forever, especially when you switch to maintaining.
